title: GuardrailsSecurityBinding
description: Contract-owned schema for the security binding document that lives in the settings-as-code home, outside the blast radius of the agents it governs. Fail-closed semantics: an ABSENT or INVALID security binding blocks autonomous dispatch — every signal enqueues human-gated; no axis serialized here ever resolves from a default or from any repo-local (agent-writable) surface.

executor_class.description: Merge-policy gating input, security-surface data per the trigger contract: vendor-hosted caps every class at human-gated merge.

dispatch_posture.description: An org may record its security settings while keeping every dispatch human-gated. Under human-gated-only a binding without an L2 surface is a deliberate posture, not a defect; under autonomous-enabled a missing L2 surface fail-closes as invalid.

isolation_bindings.description: Keyed by EXECUTION SURFACE (org-named surface id), so one surface's binding can never satisfy the check for a different dispatch surface. Each surface maps level tokens to a bound substrate instance.

merge_policy.description: Per-class merge disposition, capped by the guardrail matrix: only the C2 cell is auto-merge ELIGIBLE (after promotion); every other class merges human, and C4/C5 human always.

verification_blocking.description: Per-layer per-class blocking knobs. The security-review leaf's shipped defaults are FLOORS: tightening is legal, weakening below a floor makes the binding invalid — the admission-rule override_justification escape does NOT apply here.

promotion_state.description: Keyed by PROMOTABLE cell id only (C2-auto-merge, C3-ai-review-blocking); an entry for a non-promotable cell (C4/C5 merge never promotes) makes the binding invalid. The bound state is a CEILING: consumers must resolve the effective state against live promotion-evidence telemetry before every autonomous dispatch/merge decision, fail-closing to unpromoted when evidence is unavailable.

escalation_routes.description: Org-bound route per escalation event class — a security-sensitive axis; every event class must route.

admission.description: The serialized admission policy the trigger contract's admission seam enforces. An absent or invalid admission object fail-closes the seam: everything enqueues human-gated.

classification.description: Signal-to-work-class classification rules, homed per signal-surface class — the mappings adapters stamp signal.work_class from (e.g. label string to class for tracker-vcs-event). A signal these rules cannot resolve is fail-closed human-gated before table evaluation.

rules.description: Decision-table rules; matching is most-specific-wins (full triple > two axes > one axis > default human-gated). Two matching rules of equal specificity with different dispositions make the binding invalid — fail-closed. A rule more permissive than the shipped default for its cell is invalid without override_justification; tightening needs none.

autonomous_concurrency.description: Total autonomous dispatches in flight at any moment — bounds fan-out across all rules and surfaces, never per rule.

items_per_run.description: Items one drain run may dispatch autonomously.

substrate.description: Bound substrate instance id (org-supplied; the ladder names substrate classes only).

probe_evidence.description: Reference to the live-validation probe transcript that proved this boundary; a binding without probe evidence is invalid. For L2/L3 the referenced transcript must VERIFY (capture shape with both assertions and a networked outer context) — under autonomous-enabled an unverifiable transcript leaves the level UNPROVEN and excluded from isolation eligibility, fail-closed.

runtime_markers.description: Per-surface TRUSTED identifying markers the dispatch seam matches platform-attested runner context against — key/value pairs drawn from metadata the executing workload cannot forge. Serialized here, on the agent-unwritable security surface, so surface attestation never falls back to a repo-local recorded id. Required non-empty on every surface under dispatch_posture autonomous-enabled; marker sets must be pairwise unambiguous under joint satisfiability across surfaces.

state.description: Promotion is a human-ratified knob flip, never automatic; demotion on contrary evidence is automatic, fail-closed, and resolved at evaluation time without writing this document.

ratified_by_change.description: The reviewable change on the governance surface that ratified the flip.

evidence_window.description: The telemetry window the promotion's evidence predicate was satisfied over.

ratified_at.description: Ratification instant — anchors the promotion epoch: contrary evidence predating it belongs to a previous epoch, already consumed by the re-earn that produced this ratification.

override_justification.description: Required when this rule is more permissive than the shipped default for any cell it matches; recorded justification makes the override reviewable.
